memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: The sons of Ham: Cush, Egypt, Put and Canaan. The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah and Sabteka. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan. - Gen 10:6-7 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
More names, more peoples - the descendants of Ham, spreading out to become nations like Egypt, Cush, and Canaan. Some of these peoples would later become enemies of God's people; others would be places of both refuge and danger in Israel's story. Yet here they all are, listed together as part of the one human family under God. Even the nations that would oppose God's purposes came from Him and remained under His sovereign hand.

This is a profound comfort when we look at the world's turmoil. Nations rise and fall, some friendly and some hostile, some godly and some deeply corrupt. But not one of them is outside God's knowledge or control. He is sovereign over every people, even those that seem to stand against Him. History is not spinning out of control; it rests in the hands of the God who names the nations.

The Bible is clear on this: "The Most High is sovereign over all kingdoms on earth" (Dan 4:17). Rulers who forget God, empires that oppose His people, cultures that reject His ways - all are still under His authority, and all will ultimately serve His purposes.

This truth steadies us in anxious times. When the news is full of hostile powers and troubling nations, we can rest, knowing that God reigns over them all. And one day, every nation listed here and every nation since will bow before Christ, "for he must reign until he has put all his enemies under his feet" (1 Cor 15:25). The nations belong to God, and His purposes cannot be thwarted.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Does the world's turmoil unsettle you, or do you rest in God's sovereignty?
- How does knowing God reigns over all nations bring you peace today?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Sovereign Lord, thank You that every nation, even those that oppose You, remains under Your control. When the world troubles me, help me rest in Your reign, trusting that Your purposes cannot be thwarted.
